law: A capability nothing calls does not exist. Grep for call sites of the implementing symbol, not module imports, not definitions. kind=import never justifies CONNECTED. Own-test-only is not wired. receipts/ are data.

Import graph is recorded as hcli_imported / hcli_import_path and cannot CONNECT. Subprocess path sites + importlib.import_module literals are gathered over every git-tracked *.py file (sparse-missing files loaded from HEAD).
